row.name: Code of Honor (Mandalorian)
row.description: Adherence to the strict Mandalorian codes of honor and combat, such as never surrendering, fighting with honor, and loyalty to one's clan or Mand'alor. Violating this code brings significant shame and social penalties within Mandalorian society. This code can be used to manipulate a Mandalorian into taking certain actions or refusing others, even against their best judgment.
